title: Finite generation of the graded section module
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $S=k[x_0,x_1]$ with its standard grading, and $P=\operatorname{Proj}S$ as in [def-sc-p1-standard]. Let $\mathcal G$ be a coherent [pqf-def-coherent] $\mathcal O_P$-module and write $\mathcal G(n)=\mathcal G\otimes\mathcal O_P(n)$ for the standard twists [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. The truncated graded $S$-module $M_{\ge 0}=\bigoplus_{n\ge 0}\Gamma(P,\mathcal G(n))$, with the action induced by multiplication by homogeneous polynomials in $S$, is finitely generated.
